Figure3: The core framework of LeTS extends conventional outcome-supervised GRPO by introducing a finegrained categorization of rollouts within each group. Specifically, generated rollouts are classified as either outperforming or underperforming, based on their relative returns. Separate reward functions are then applied to each category to compute process-level rewards. Finally, the rollout-level advantages are rescaled at the step level using an advantage normalization procedure, enabling more precise credit assignment during policy updates.
